guide.amethystmod.subtitle: Everything about the Amethyst
guide.amethystmod.world.title: The Infection
guide.amethystmod.world.text: The Amethyst infection grows from cores: crystals scattered over the world, more and older the further you go from the tower. Around each core its land turns violet: grass, dirt, sand and trees first; older cores take bare stone too. Crystals sprout and grow on it: a bud becomes a crystal, then a large crystal. The land of a core keeps growing while the core lives; destroy the core and its land stops growing, but stays infected. The tower at 0, 0 stands in its own land, infected from the start. Only the fall of the Heart of the Amethyst makes the infection fade, very slowly. Speed: /gamerule amethystInfectionSpeed 0-1000 (0 stops it). The infection only works near players and with a fixed budget, so it never slows the game. Purified armor, the Purifier's Blade and wards burn the infection away.
guide.amethystmod.cores.title: Infection Cores
guide.amethystmod.cores.text: A core grows through three phases with age (6 and 15 in-game days by default). Phase 1: a lone crystal about a block tall; one or two blows break it; its land is soil, sand and trees. Phase 2: two blocks tall; it calls weak creatures of the Amethyst around itself, its land grows faster, takes stone, raises crystal pikes and turns into the Crystal Wastes. Phase 3: a three-block monolith that shoots shards and raises crystals under your feet, calls dangerous creatures and hides behind a barrier that only purified amethyst can pierce: purified weapons and armor pieces held in hand, the purified spear and its light. The barrier grows back if you stop. From phase 2 on, cores throw crystal geodes now and then: each lands somewhere free and becomes a new core of phase 1. After the Heart's fall every core fades away within a few days. Ops: /amethyst core list, spawn <phase>, upgrade [all|radius <r>], set <phase>, kill [all|radius <r>], geode <phase>, throw, stats; /gamerule amethystCorePhase2Days and amethystCorePhase3Days.
guide.amethystmod.blocks.title: Crystals and Blocks
guide.amethystmod.blocks.text: Crystals come in violet, rose and azure, and three sizes. Break them for amethyst essence. From essence you craft: the Amethyst Crystal Block (4 essence), Amethyst Bricks (4 blocks make 4 bricks), Brilliant Amethyst (a crystal block with glowstone dust, light 15), Clear Amethyst (smelt infected sand), Clear Amethyst Panes (6 clear blocks make 16) and Brick Slabs (3 bricks make 6).
guide.amethystmod.materials.title: Crystals of Power
guide.amethystmod.materials.text: Flame Crystal: amethyst essence ringed by four blaze rods. Frost Crystal: essence ringed by eight ice blocks. Purified Amethyst: four essence, a diamond and a nether quartz make two. The flame and frost crystals power the staffs, the berserker core and the stasis crystal; purified amethyst makes the Purifier's armor.
guide.amethystmod.tower.title: The Amethyst Tower
guide.amethystmod.tower.text: At world coordinates 0, 0 stands the Amethyst Tower, a giant amethyst cluster: an eight-sided crystal shaft with huge crystals bursting out of the ground and its walls, crowned by a crystal point. The door faces south. Five floors are linked by a spiral stair of half-steps along the wall, with one guard on each: stalkers (1), a lurker (2), a shard-walker (3), weavers (4), a geode colossus (5). Every floor has a chest, better ones higher up; the purity amulet can turn up in them. At the top, in a hall of crystal pillars, waits Amitariel. Ops: /amethyst tower build rebuilds the tower, /amethyst tower tp takes you to its door.
guide.amethystmod.resonant_shard.title: Resonant Shard
guide.amethystmod.resonant_shard.text: A shard that still hums with the song of the Amethyst. Any creature of the Amethyst can drop one: stalkers and weavers rarely, lurkers and walkers more often, a geode colossus always (2-3), Amitariel 3-5. Tower chests hold them too. Good gear needs them: every piece of amethyst and purified armor, the crystal hammer and the amethyst shield.
guide.amethystmod.food.title: Food
guide.amethystmod.food.text: Purified Crystal Apple (an apple ringed by four purified amethyst): Regeneration II for 10 seconds and Absorption for 2 minutes, cures the blight, can be eaten when full. Purified Crystal Bread (three wheat and a purified amethyst): very filling, a little regeneration, cures the blight. Country Potatoes with Sauce (three baked potatoes, a beetroot and a bowl): Strength and Resistance for 2 minutes. Mmm, what tasty potatoes! Cereal with Milk: the best breakfast there is, with speed, regeneration, haste and high jumps for a minute; it cannot be crafted, it is sold by a traveller you may meet one day.
guide.amethystmod.commands.title: Tips and Commands
guide.amethystmod.commands.text: Artifacts work from any inventory slot; right-click them to use. Staffs cut off after a few seconds and need to cool down. Armor sets give a bonus only when all four pieces are worn. Commands: /gamerule amethystInfectionSpeed 0-1000, /amethyst tower build, /amethyst tower tp, /amethyst core (see Infection Cores). Spawn eggs of every creature are in the creative tab.
guide.amethystmod.stalker.title: Amethyst Stalker
guide.amethystmod.stalker.text: A crystal wolf. 34 health, bites for 7 and pounces. Its bite spreads the amethyst blight. Spawns only on infected ground, on the surface and underground, and in the first floor of the tower. Drops 0-2 amethyst essence.
guide.amethystmod.weaver.title: Crystal Weaver
guide.amethystmod.weaver.text: A crystal spider that climbs walls and ceilings. 26 health, bites for 5 and spreads the blight. Lives on infected ground and on the first floor of the tower. Drops essence and string.
guide.amethystmod.walker.title: Shard-Walker
guide.amethystmod.walker.text: A tall humanoid of the tower. 80 health, heavy blows of 11. From range it throws a fan of three crystal shards, then closes in. Found on floors 3 and 6. Drops 2-4 essence and sometimes purified amethyst.
guide.amethystmod.lurker.title: Void-Crystal Lurker
guide.amethystmod.lurker.text: A fast raptor with sickle claws. 46 health, bites for 9 and leaps onto its prey from a distance. Found on floors 2, 4 and 7. Drops 1-2 essence.
guide.amethystmod.colossus.title: Geode Colossus
guide.amethystmod.colossus.text: A huge, slow golem you cannot knock back. 240 health, hits for 22. When you come close it raises its arms and slams the ground: a shockwave of radius 9 for 16 damage that throws you into the air. Found on floors 5 and 7. Drops 6-12 essence and sometimes flame or frost crystals.
guide.amethystmod.drifter.title: Celestial Drifter
guide.amethystmod.drifter.text: A winged creature with tentacles that floats above you at a distance. 100 health. It fires volleys of five crystal shards, so close in fast or use a bow. Found on floors 4 and 6. Drops 3-6 essence and sometimes a frost crystal.
guide.amethystmod.amitariel.title: Amitariel
guide.amethystmod.amitariel.text: The apostle of the Amethyst waits at the top of the tower. He speaks first and offers you to join the Amethyst: answer "yes" in chat and you die, answer "no" (or stay silent) and the fight begins. Phase 1: lunges, shard barrages, crystal pillars under every player, guards at low health. Below half health he transforms and adds a shard storm and blink strikes. 450 health, more with more players. He whirls with his spear (step out of the circle), leaps and smashes the floor where you stood (run from the rune circle, crystals grow there), and summons spears of light that aim at you one by one (a thin line shows each one's path: step aside). When he falls, he drops his spear and a rift into the world of the Amethyst tears open in his hall.
guide.amethystmod.heart.title: The Amethyst Heart
guide.amethystmod.heart.text: The final boss, a living crystal heart over ten blocks across, in the temple at the centre of the Amethyst world. The fight has five stages. 1: five crystals around the arena shield it and shoot at you: break them all. Then four phases, each with its own health bar, larger every time: empty one and the next begins. Each phase exposes new weak points and closes the old ones. 2 Awakening: the nodes at its roots. 3 Resonance: the lower armour plates break off, strike the glowing wounds on its chest and back. 4 Crystallization: the armour falls away, strike the crystal veins under its belly. 5 Agony: no defence left, strike it anywhere; below 8% a 30 second countdown to a blast over the whole arena. Weak points are sealed and open only for a few seconds after each attack, then they take double damage; the rest of the body takes little. Watch the rune circles: they show where crystals will burst or fall. Its attacks include crystal spirals, crystals that chase you (keep running), zones of growing and falling crystals, a pentagon of giant crystals, glowing rings and floor beams (jump over them) and the death beam: a thin line aims at someone, then fires (step aside!). Later phases drop the weak attacks and combine several at once. If everyone dies or leaves, it heals and the shield returns. Victory tears open a rift home and stops the infection in the normal world.
guide.amethystmod.portal.title: The Rift
guide.amethystmod.portal.text: When Amitariel falls, space tears open in the middle of his hall: a tall rift of light. Stand in it for a moment and it carries you into the world of the Amethyst; you land somewhere 150-500 blocks from its temple. The way back is a second rift, which opens in the temple when the Heart falls and leads back to Amitariel's hall.
guide.amethystmod.amethyst_world.title: The World of the Amethyst
guide.amethystmod.amethyst_world.text: Eternal violet twilight under the stars. Islands of crystal float over the void: crystal groves with giant crystals, deep amethyst canyons, quiet meadows, clear amethyst lakes and the shard wastes, broken into small floating islands. Sometimes crystal rain falls. Only creatures of the Amethyst live here, and they do not need darkness. Beds work: set your spawn before the fight.
guide.amethystmod.temple.title: The Temple of the Amethyst
guide.amethystmod.temple.text: At the centre of the world (0, 0) a cathedral under a crystal dome floats on its own island. Inside: a round arena with columns along the edge to hide behind, five crystal pedestals and, in the middle, the Heart. When the Heart falls, a rift home opens in the middle of the arena.
guide.amethystmod.amethyst_tools.title: Amethyst Tools
guide.amethystmod.amethyst_tools.text: Pickaxe, axe, shovel and hoe of amethyst: mining level above iron, 2200 durability, high enchantability. Repaired with amethyst essence.
guide.amethystmod.amethyst_sword.title: Amethyst Blade
guide.amethystmod.amethyst_sword.text: 35% of blows burst into crystal shards that hit everything around the target. Right-click: a crystal dash through enemies in a line (6 seconds cooldown).
guide.amethystmod.flame_brand.title: Flame Brand
guide.amethystmod.flame_brand.text: Every blow sets the target ablaze. Right-click: a wide burst of fire that burns everything in front of you for 9 damage (8 seconds cooldown).
guide.amethystmod.frost_edge.title: Frost Edge
guide.amethystmod.frost_edge.text: Blows slow and chill the target. Right-click: a nova of cold around you that damages, slows and weakens everything within 6 blocks (11 seconds cooldown).
guide.amethystmod.storm_blade.title: Storm Blade
guide.amethystmod.storm_blade.text: 30% of blows call down lightning on the target. Right-click: chain lightning that leaps from enemy to enemy, up to six of them, for 9 damage each (10 seconds cooldown).
guide.amethystmod.void_edge.title: Void Edge
guide.amethystmod.void_edge.text: Blows weaken the target and make it glow, and heal you a little. Right-click: slip through space up to 10 blocks forward, cutting everything on the way for 11 damage (5 seconds cooldown).
guide.amethystmod.purifier_blade.title: Purifier's Blade
guide.amethystmod.purifier_blade.text: Deals 10 extra damage to creatures of the Amethyst and cleanses your blight. Right-click: a flash that burns the infection from the ground around you, scorches creatures of the Amethyst within 8 blocks for 18 and heals you (7 seconds cooldown).
guide.amethystmod.flame_staff.title: Flame Staff
guide.amethystmod.flame_staff.text: Hold right-click for a flamethrower that sets everything in a cone on fire. It cuts off after 4 seconds and cools down, and enemies are not pushed back.
guide.amethystmod.frost_staff.title: Frost Staff
guide.amethystmod.frost_staff.text: Right-click: a wave of cold that freezes and slows enemies in a cone and turns water to ice. 5 seconds cooldown.
guide.amethystmod.prism_scepter.title: Prism Scepter
guide.amethystmod.prism_scepter.text: Hold right-click for a piercing beam of crystal light that hits everything on its line. It cuts off after 3 seconds and cools down.
guide.amethystmod.crescent_blade.title: Crescent Blade
guide.amethystmod.crescent_blade.text: A curved crystal saber. Hold right-click and let go: crescents of light fly from the blade, pass through enemies (each is cut once) and break on walls. Each half second of holding adds one (up to 5 at three seconds), and they grow bigger and hit harder (6 to 12 damage each). The cooldown grows with the charge. Made from an amethyst sword, four purified amethyst and two resonant shards.
guide.amethystmod.purified_spear.title: Purified Crystal Spear
guide.amethystmod.purified_spear.text: Amitariel's spear, made pure: craft it from his spear, four purified amethyst and a resonant shard. Hold right-click: a spear of white light appears over you about three times a second and flies to the point you were looking at when it appeared; turn to aim the next ones, the ones already flying keep their course (6 damage each). Keep holding for ten seconds and it bursts into a volley: 18 spears fire one after another, like a machine gun, at whatever you look at (7 damage each). After the volley it rests for 15 seconds.
guide.amethystmod.crystal_hammer.title: Crystal Hammer
guide.amethystmod.crystal_hammer.text: A heavy hammer. Hold right-click: you leap up and hang in the air while the blow charges for 3 seconds, then dive into the ground. Enemies within 7 blocks take up to 18 damage and are hurled away, crystals burst around you, and every enemy hit heals you (4 health plus 2 per enemy). Let go early and you just drop. No fall damage from the dive. Cooldown 8 seconds.
guide.amethystmod.amitariel_spear.title: Spear of Amitariel
guide.amethystmod.amitariel_spear.text: The apostle's own spear, which he drops when he falls. A strong melee weapon. Tap right-click: you whirl for 3 seconds with the spear held out, cutting everything around you every half second (7 damage). Hold right-click a moment (until it chimes) and let go: you dash forward spinning, and the dash ends in a sweep that deals 8 damage around you and throws enemies back. No fall damage during the dash. Cooldowns: 6 seconds after the whirl, 3.5 after the dash.
guide.amethystmod.talis_hammer.title: Jaybee Talis's Hammer
guide.amethystmod.talis_hammer.text: Hold right-click to charge for up to 5 seconds: the hammer crackles with lightning. Release to smash the floor: thunder strikes, everything around takes electric damage and is hurled away. A full charge hits a radius of 12 blocks for up to 40 damage. Cooldown grows with the charge.
guide.amethystmod.crystal_bow.title: Crystal Bow and Arrows
guide.amethystmod.crystal_bow.text: A bow of crystal and string, 900 durability. Crystal arrows shatter on impact: everything within 3 blocks of the target takes 5 damage and glows. Craft four arrows from essence, a stick and a feather. Normal arrows work too.
guide.amethystmod.amethyst_shield.title: Amethyst Shield
guide.amethystmod.amethyst_shield.text: Blocks like a normal shield, and whatever it stops takes 5 damage and is pushed back by a crystal burst. 750 durability, repaired with essence.
guide.amethystmod.amethyst_armor.title: Amethyst Armor
guide.amethystmod.amethyst_armor.text: Strong armor of crystal with crystal crests, shoulder spikes and a glowing back. The full set grants Crystal Resonance: more damage, faster strikes and extra speed. Each piece is made of amethyst crystal blocks with a resonant shard.
guide.amethystmod.purified_armor.title: Purifier's Armor
guide.amethystmod.purified_armor.text: Made of purified amethyst, with a halo and wings of light. Each piece takes 15% off the damage from creatures of the Amethyst. The full set grants the Anti-Amethyst Ward: 80% less damage from them, immunity to the blight, healing on infected ground and a cleansing aura that burns the infection away. Each piece is made of purified amethyst with a resonant shard.
guide.amethystmod.aegis_heart.title: Aegis Heart
guide.amethystmod.aegis_heart.text: In the inventory: constant resistance. Right-click: a thick crystal shell of absorption and resistance for 15-20 seconds. Cooldown 90 seconds.
guide.amethystmod.amethyst_wings.title: Amethyst Wings
guide.amethystmod.amethyst_wings.text: Right-click: you are thrown up and can fly freely for 25 seconds, leaving a trail of sparks. Slow falling keeps you safe afterward. Cooldown 60 seconds.
guide.amethystmod.blink_ring.title: Blink Ring
guide.amethystmod.blink_ring.text: In the inventory: extra speed. Right-click: teleport up to 14 blocks along your gaze. Cooldown 5 seconds.
guide.amethystmod.vampiric_shard.title: Vampiric Shard
guide.amethystmod.vampiric_shard.text: In the inventory: every enemy you kill restores a quarter of its maximum health to you (up to 10).
guide.amethystmod.berserker_core.title: Berserker Core
guide.amethystmod.berserker_core.text: Right-click: 20 seconds of Strength III, Speed II and Haste III. Afterwards a crash: weakness, slowness and hunger for 12 seconds. Cooldown 2 minutes.
guide.amethystmod.stasis_crystal.title: Stasis Crystal
guide.amethystmod.stasis_crystal.text: Right-click: every enemy within 12 blocks is frozen in time for 8 seconds and glows. Cooldown 45 seconds.
guide.amethystmod.gravity_orb.title: Gravity Orb
guide.amethystmod.gravity_orb.text: Right-click: pulls every enemy within 16 blocks to you and batters them. Cooldown 30 seconds.
guide.amethystmod.crystal_totem.title: Crystal Totem
guide.amethystmod.crystal_totem.text: In the inventory: once, it saves you from death, restores health and releases a shockwave that damages and pushes back enemies. It is used up.
guide.amethystmod.thunder_shard.title: Thunder Shard
guide.amethystmod.thunder_shard.text: Right-click: three lightning strikes land where you look, up to 48 blocks away. Cooldown 10 seconds.
guide.amethystmod.purity_aegis.title: Aegis of Purity
guide.amethystmod.purity_aegis.text: A shield of light you carry in your inventory. Charge it there: pick up purified amethyst with the mouse and right-click the aegis with it (each piece is 10%, ten for a full charge; the bar under the icon shows the charge). While it is charged, a see-through dome surrounds you and you get a row of up to eight white hearts over your health: they take damage first and regrow on their own when you are not hit for three seconds. Every point they take or regrow uses up 1% of the charge; when it runs out, the dome and the white hearts disappear. Made from seven purified amethyst, a resonant shard and a diamond.
guide.amethystmod.purity_amulet.title: Purity Amulet
guide.amethystmod.purity_amulet.text: A pale crystal on a silver chain. Carry it in your inventory: the amethyst blight cannot take hold of you, and creatures of the Amethyst deal 25% less damage (on top of purified armor). It cannot be crafted: look for it in the chests of the tower.
tooltip.amethystmod.set.amethyst: Full set: Crystal Resonance. More damage, faster strikes, extra speed.
tooltip.amethystmod.set.purified: Full set: Anti-Amethyst Ward. -80% damage from amethyst creatures, immune to blight, heals on infected ground and burns the infection away.
